mentions.name: cardspark_ui
mentions.description: A free library of polished, themable UI components for trading card game (TCG) apps — like shadcn for Pokémon cards. The first release includes cards, grids, stacks, filters, value charts, and detail pages, so hobbyists and sellers building DIY collecting tools don't have to recreate the same UI primitives badly.
mentions.problem: Hobbyists and sellers building DIY collecting tools mostly lack a design background and get stuck recreating the same UI primitives badly.
mentions.audience: Hobbyists and sellers building trading card game (TCG) apps without a design background
mentions.source_excerpt: Just published the first version of cardspark_ui [1], a library of polished, themable UI components for TCG apps. Kind of like shadcn for pokémon cards
mentions.author: reb
